summary.text: Brenda Steady is a Republican state representative from Chittenden-25 who has served in the Vermont House of Representatives since January 2025 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election against Democrat Julia Andrews.
She works as a substitute teacher.

paragraphs.text: Brenda Steady was born in Milton, Vermont.
Her career experience includes working as a bookkeeper, personal assistant and substitute teacher.
Steady assumed office on January 8, 2025, succeeding Julia Andrews, and advanced from the Republican primary on August 11, 2026.
